plans.note: Section 9 is the express limitation of liability; check mutuality, cap size and whether indemnity (sec-8-2) and confidentiality (sec-10) breaches are carved out.

Section 8 Indemnification should give us (Corio, as licensee/host) IP infringement cover from Commerce One; confirm our reciprocal indemnity is narrow and that sec-9 does not cap the vendor indemnity.

Grant of Rights plus the defined terms CORIO MARKET SEGMENT and TERRITORY suggest field-of-use or competing-product limits on our business; check sec-3 and the definitions for any prohibition on offering competing solutions.
Look for exclusive-sourcing or preferred-partner language in Grant of Rights and in Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation; confirm we remain free to license competing procurement software.
No pricing-parity heading is visible; scan Fees and Exhibit B pricing/revenue sharing for any obligation on us to extend best terms to Commerce One. MFN running in our favour is acceptable.
No dedicated non-solicit heading; check Miscellaneous and the confidentiality/personnel provisions for a hiring restriction on us, and for a general-advertising carve-out if present.
Section 11 Term and Termination governs; verify we have a convenience exit on notice and that Commerce One cannot terminate at will mid-term.
Check the term structure in sec-11 for auto-renewal, notice window length and any renewal price uplift referenced in Exhibit B pricing.
Governing law, venue and any arbitration reference (the defined term RULES hints at arbitral rules) should sit in Miscellaneous; confirm an accepted jurisdiction and court access.
Assignment clause expected in Miscellaneous; confirm we may assign to affiliates and successors and that a change of control of Corio does not give Commerce One a termination right.
Check the DEVELOPMENTS definition and Grant of Rights for ownership of customizations we pay for and of customer data on the CORIO SERVERS; trademark use sits in sec-6.

Section 2 Grant of Rights with the SOFTWARE/DEMONSTRATION SOFTWARE definitions and Exhibit A; confirm scope covers our affiliates, contractors and CUSTOMERS and that the licence is not revocable at will.
Revenue-sharing fees usually carry a records-inspection right; check Fees and Exhibit B payment terms for audit frequency, notice, location and who bears cost.
Look for late-payment interest, penalties or shortfall payments in Fees and Exhibit B payment terms; service credits flowing to us are acceptable.

Section 7 Warranties and Disclaimer plus the Warranty Period and Acceptance Test definitions; check duration, remedy and the breadth of the disclaimer, with maintenance obligations in sec-5 and Exhibit C.
No insurance heading appears in the outline; confirm nothing in Miscellaneous or Shared Resources before treating as missing.

Exhibit B pricing and revenue-sharing fees, together with the IMPLEMENTATION FEE and APPLICATION MANAGEMENT REVENUE definitions, may impose minimum guarantees on us; check for an exit or true-up relief.

Check the post-termination effects in sec-11 for wind-down, continued service to existing CUSTOMERS and data return; source code escrow in sec-12 is a partial substitute but not full transition assistance.
